'''Coline''' is the cook at the [[The Queen's Blessing]] in [[Caemlyn]].

==Appearance==
She is round with her hair in a bun.

==History==
She recalls that Rand "looked so like [[Tigraine Mantear|Tigraine]]". It is unknown how she knows what the Daughter-Heir looked like. This would, however, put her age at over 40.

Although Coline is her name, everyone calles her "Cook".{{ref/book|3|45}}

She has so much authority in the inn, and over [[Basel Gill]], that many assume that she is his wife.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Coline}}

==Activities==
She is in the kitchen when [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]] and [[Matrim Cauthon|Mat]] arrive.{{ref/book|1|35}}

She is still in the kitchen when [[Mat]] arrives back from his attempt to deliver [[Elayne]]'s letter.{{ref/book|3|45}} She gives Mat instructions for [[Basel Gill]] to clean out the drains.
